payload.prompt:
Extend the logging hook (no app code changes):

1. In .github/hooks/scripts/log-interaction.js, on the Stop event the payload has
   transcript_path pointing to Copilot's session events.jsonl. When it exists:
   - Read it line by line (JSONL). Keep only: user.message, assistant.message,
     tool.execution_start, tool.execution_complete, permission.requested, permission.completed.
   - Write a readable Markdown transcript to ai-logs/transcripts/<UTC date>-<sessionId>.md
     (overwrite if it exists — Stop can fire more than once per session):
     timestamp + role/type, message text, tool name + short arguments, permission decision.
   - Same redaction; truncate each entry to 2,000 characters with "…[truncated]".
   - Never copy system.message content.
   Put the transcript logic in a function that can also be run manually.

2. Add a small script .github/hooks/scripts/backfill-transcripts.js that takes session ids
   as arguments, reads C:\Users\sonis\.copilot\session-state\<id>\events.jsonl and writes
   transcripts the same way. Run it for these past sessions:
   1145d9f1-ca99-44b4-bda3-69ffef789dae, c95e488e-08c7-46b1-8754-2d94c5485018,
   4da15382-fcfb-4ed1-86dd-8dff609c29ae

Keep everything else unchanged; the hook must still always exit 0 with no stdout. Do not commit.
